note: Invented sample: two air shipments to Manila in one forwarded mail, 'Shipment 1' (3 crates in inches + 1 package on a second HAWB, FCA Dayton OH) and 'Shipment 2' (9 pallets in cm, EXW Nashua NH). Two cargo lines instead of one merged list; shipment 1's stated total leaves out the package (the items are kept), shipment 2's items do not add up to its stated total (the total is kept).
subject: FW: two air shipments USA to Manila airport Philippines - pls check
